page.layout: One printed title page, one block of centred lines. No margins or notes. Show-through from the reverse side runs through the middle lines, and two round stamps or seals sit at the lower edge, which are not printed text.
page.notes: The title page is heavily stained and shows mirrored show-through from the reverse, so the middle lines (after "USU PATRUM") and the lower imprint line are not legible. The name "IOANNIS DALLEI" and "USU PATRUM" are read with some confidence; the word "DE" between them and the place name "GENEVÆ" are also uncertain. The large circular seals and the dark rectangular stain are not text and were left out.
